```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
run <- oaireport::load_results()$default
colours <- oaireport::brief_colours
assumption <- function(key) run$assumptions$assumptions[[key]]$value
num <- function(x, digits = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",")
count <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
pct <- function(x) paste0(num(100 * x, 0), "%")
wave <- function(x) sprintf("%02d", as.integer(x))
one <- function(df, ...) {
  cond <- list(...)
  keep <- Reduce(`&`, Map(function(col, value) !is.na(df[[col]]) & df[[col]] == value, names(cond), cond))
  row <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) != 1) stop("expected one row for ", paste(names(cond), unlist(cond), sep = " = ", collapse = ", "),
                           ", found ", nrow(row), call. = FALSE)
  row
}
share <- run$walking_share; share$visit <- wave(share$visit)
pb <- run$cadence_bands_person; pb$visit <- wave(pb$visit)
acc <- run$pro_accuracy
rho <- run$pro_spearman
dflow <- run$device_flow; dflow$wave <- wave(dflow$wave)
cads <- unlist(assumption("reference.step_cadences"))
low <- paste0("steps_", min(cads))
mv_cut <- count(assumption("device.mv_cutpoint"))
min_days <- assumption("reference.min_bout_days_per_week")

sh <- function(measure, cadence = 40) one(share, visit = "06", cadence_ge = cadence, measure = measure)$pooled
band_mean <- function(band, measure) one(pb, visit = "06", band = band, measure = measure)$mean
a <- function(pro, family, rule = "bout_days") one(acc, pro = pro, definition = paste0(family, ":", rule))
sp <- function(pro, family, rule = "bout_days") num(a(pro, family, rule)$specificity)
range_sp <- function(pros, families, rule = "bout_days") {
  x <- unlist(lapply(pros, function(p) vapply(families, function(f) a(p, f, rule)$specificity, 0)))
  paste0(num(min(x)), "–", num(max(x)))
}
families <- c("counts_mv", paste0("steps_", cads))
pase_any <- c("pase06_any", "pase08_any", "pase10_any")
pase_freq <- c("pase06_frequent", "pase08_frequent", "pase10_frequent")
```

Per-minute step counts for the 48- and 72-month accelerometry weeks (prepared by the Northwestern accelerometry group) match the public minute files. `r count(one(dflow, wave = "06")$valid_with_step_measures)` and `r count(one(dflow, wave = "08")$valid_with_step_measures)` participants with valid wear have steps; the 72-month steps are new.

**MV** (moderate-to-vigorous activity): a minute with at least `r mv_cut` activity counts, the release's cut-point.

# How much of the activity counts is walking

```{r fig-bands, fig.height = 2.9, fig.cap = paste0("Mean share (bars, with 95% CI) of each participant's wear minutes and activity counts by steps a minute, 48 months (72 months is similar). Thin grey lines: middle 50% of participants. Labels: mean share of a band's minutes that are MV (≥ ", mv_cut, " counts a minute).")}
b <- pb[pb$visit == "06", ]
lev <- unique(b$band)
b$band <- factor(b$band, levels = lev)
bars <- b[b$measure %in% c("share_of_minutes", "share_of_counts"), ]
bars$what <- factor(ifelse(bars$measure == "share_of_minutes", "Wear minutes", "Activity counts"),
                    levels = c("Wear minutes", "Activity counts"))
mv <- b[b$measure == "share_minutes_mv", ]
top <- aggregate(q3 ~ band, data = bars, FUN = max)
mv <- merge(mv, setNames(top, c("band", "top")), by = "band")
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.75)
ggplot(bars, aes(band, mean, fill = what)) +
  geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.7) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q3), position = dodge, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), position = dodge, width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(data = mv, aes(band, top + 0.04, label = paste0(round(100 * mean), "% MV")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.4, colour = colours[["label"]]) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(colours[["muted"]], colours[["navy"]]), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = "Steps a minute", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

- **Most activity counts are not walking.** The largest share of a participant's counts comes from minutes with 1–19 steps (mean `r pct(band_mean("1-19", "share_of_counts"))`).
- **Most MV is walking.** At 40 or more steps a minute, `r pct(sh("mv_minutes_walking"))` of MV minutes are walking minutes.
- **Most walking is not MV.** Only `r pct(band_mean("60-79", "share_minutes_mv"))` of minutes at 60–79 steps a minute are MV.

# Self-reported walking against device walking

A **device walker** has a walking bout on at least `r min_days` days a week (no published standard exists; a 1-day rule is compared in the text). A **walking bout** lasts 10 or more minutes, 8 of every 10 at or above a threshold: `r mv_cut` counts a minute (an MV bout) or `r paste(cads, collapse = ", ")` steps a minute (a step bout; 100 is roughly moderate intensity). PASE at 48 and 72 months is compared with that visit's device week; the 96-month Walking Question and PASE with the mean of both weeks.

```{r fig-accuracy, fig.height = 4.1, fig.cap = paste0("Sensitivity and specificity (95% CI) of each self-report against device walkers (a walking bout on ", min_days, "+ days a week). MV bouts: ≥ ", mv_cut, " counts a minute (moderate-to-vigorous); step bouts: ≥ 40, 60 or 100 steps a minute. Walking Question: walked for exercise since age 50. PASE: walked outside the home on any day, or on 3+ days, in the past week.")}
family_labels <- c(counts_mv = paste0("MV bouts (≥ ", mv_cut, " counts/min)"),
                   setNames(paste0("Step bouts ≥ ", cads, "/min"), paste0("steps_", cads)))
pro_order <- c("item96", "pase06_any", "pase06_frequent", "pase08_any", "pase08_frequent", "pase10_any", "pase10_frequent")
pro_short <- c(item96 = "Walking Question, 96 mo", pase06_any = "PASE any, 48 mo", pase06_frequent = "PASE 3+ d, 48 mo",
               pase08_any = "PASE any, 72 mo", pase08_frequent = "PASE 3+ d, 72 mo",
               pase10_any = "PASE any, 96 mo", pase10_frequent = "PASE 3+ d, 96 mo")
d <- acc[grepl(":bout_days$", acc$definition), ]
d$family <- factor(family_labels[d$family], levels = family_labels)
d$pro <- factor(pro_short[d$pro], levels = rev(pro_short[pro_order]))
long <- rbind(data.frame(d[c("pro", "family")], stat = "Sensitivity", est = d$sensitivity, lo = d$sensitivity_lo, hi = d$sensitivity_hi),
              data.frame(d[c("pro", "family")], stat = "Specificity", est = d$specificity, lo = d$specificity_lo, hi = d$specificity_hi))
ggplot(long, aes(est, pro, colour = family)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), position = position_dodge(width = 0.65), size = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~stat, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(colours[["pase"]], "#7aa6d6", colours[["item"]], colours[["navy"]]), name = NULL) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(1.2, "lines"))
```

## The 96-month Walking Question

Specificity is `r sp("item96", "counts_mv")` against MV bouts and `r sp("item96", low)` against step bouts at `r min(cads)` steps a minute, which count slow walking. Most of the least active participants still answer yes. A 1-day rule gives `r range_sp("item96", families, "any_bout")` across bout types (2+ days: `r range_sp("item96", families)`).

## PASE walking (48, 72 and 96 months)

"Any walking" behaves like the Walking Question: specificity `r range_sp(pase_any, families)` across bout types (1-day rule: `r range_sp(pase_any, families, "any_bout")`). Walking on 3+ days roughly doubles specificity (`r range_sp(pase_freq, low)` against step bouts at `r min(cads)`), at some cost in sensitivity.

# What this suggests

Counting slow walking barely changes how often less active participants report walking. The questions may capture walking one device week misses, or reported walking a device would not record; these data cannot tell which.

**For the Northwestern group:** a standard step-based walking definition for the GT1M? Setting differences between waves? A preferred step measure?
